title: At the nasi campur counter
blurb: Pointing, choosing lauk, and how much kuah you really want.

notes.title: yang ni, yang tu
notes.body: When you don't know the name, point: yang ni (this one), yang tu (that one). ni and tu are short for ini and itu.

notes.title: banjir
notes.body: Kuah banjir — literally “flooded gravy” — means drench the rice. The opposite is kuah sikit or letak tepi (on the side).

notes.title: separuh
notes.body: Portions of rice are big. Nasi separuh gets you half; nasi tambah gets you extra.

p2.note: lauk = the dishes that go with rice.

p4.en: It's a bit spicy, you know.

p5.note: banjir = flood; lots of gravy over the rice.

p11.en: Does it have a lot of bones?

p12.en: Just take the chicken, it's easier.

p13.ms: Kuah nak banjir ke letak tepi?
p13.en: Gravy flooded or on the side?

p14.en: Don't let it touch the vegetables.

dialogue.ms: Lauk nak apa?
dialogue.en: Which dishes do you want?

dialogue.ms: Ayam goreng satu.
dialogue.en: One fried chicken.

dialogue.ms: Sayur?
dialogue.en: Vegetables?

dialogue.ms: Nak yang ni.
dialogue.en: I want this one.

dialogue.ms: Kuah?
dialogue.en: Gravy?

dialogue.ms: Kuah kari. Sikit je.
dialogue.en: Curry gravy. Just a little.

gist.q: How much gravy does she want?
gist.why: Kuah kari. Sikit je — just a little.

listen.en: I want that one. Just a little.

listen.ms: Ayam goreng satu, sayur, kuah kari sikit. Itu je?
listen.en: One fried chicken, vegetables, a little curry gravy. Is that all?

read.why: He's asking about gravy; tak nak kuah says none.
Either/or: pick one of the two.

read.en: I want just a little curry gravy.

dialogue.ms: Bang, nasi separuh ye.
dialogue.en: Half rice, please.

dialogue.ms: Okay. Lauk nak apa?
dialogue.en: Okay. Which dishes do you want?

dialogue.ms: Ayam goreng satu, dengan sayur yang ni.
dialogue.en: One fried chicken, with this vegetable.

dialogue.ms: Sayur kangkung ni? Pedas sikit tau.
dialogue.en: This kangkung? It's a bit spicy, you know.

dialogue.ms: Takpe, pedas sikit okay. Kuah nak banjir.
dialogue.en: That's fine, a bit spicy is okay. I want the gravy flooded.

dialogue.ms: Kuah kari ke kuah campur?
dialogue.en: Curry gravy or mixed gravy?

dialogue.ms: Campur lah. Telur masin ada tak?
dialogue.en: Mixed. Do you have salted egg?

dialogue.ms: Ada. Nak satu?
dialogue.en: Yes. Want one?

dialogue.ms: Nak satu. Itu je.
dialogue.en: One, please. That's all.

gist.q: What does she ask for with her rice?
options: Half rice, fried chicken, kangkung, lots of mixed gravy and a salted egg
Full rice, fish, no vegetables and no gravy
Half rice with only vegetables and curry on the side
gist.why: Nasi separuh … ayam goreng … sayur … kuah banjir, campur … telur masin.

listen.ms: Sayur ni tak pedas, yang tu pedas sikit.
listen.en: This vegetable isn't spicy; that one is a bit spicy.

listen.ms: Kuah tak nak banjir. Sikit je.
listen.en: I don't want the gravy flooded. Just a little.

listen.ms: Bang, nasi biasa ye. Ayam goreng satu, sayur tak nak. Kuah kari banjir.
listen.en: Regular rice, please. One fried chicken, no vegetables. Flood it with curry gravy.

read.right: Tak nak lah. Sayur lain ada tak?
read.why: Not okay for you, so ask for a different vegetable.
A plain no, and you're done: itu je.

dialogue.ms: Ya, nasi biasa ke nasi tambah?
dialogue.en: Yes, regular rice or extra rice?

dialogue.ms: Nasi separuh je bang, tengah diet sikit.
dialogue.en: Just half rice, I'm on a bit of a diet.

dialogue.ms: Haha, okay. Lauk ambik apa?
dialogue.en: Haha, okay. Which dishes are you taking?

dialogue.ms: Yang tu ikan apa eh? Yang merah tu.
dialogue.en: What fish is that one? The red one.

dialogue.ms: Tu ikan kembung masak sambal. Sebelah tu ayam masak merah.
dialogue.en: That's mackerel cooked in sambal. Next to it is ayam masak merah.

dialogue.ms: Ikan tu ada tulang banyak tak?
dialogue.en: Does that fish have a lot of bones?

dialogue.ms: Ikan kembung memang ada tulang sikit lah. Kalau malas, ambik ayam je, senang.
dialogue.en: Mackerel does have some bones. If you can't be bothered, just take the chicken, it's easier.

dialogue.ms: Okay lah, ayam masak merah satu. Dengan sayur campur tu sikit.
dialogue.en: Okay then, one ayam masak merah. With a bit of that mixed veg.

dialogue.ms: Kuah nak banjir ke letak tepi?
dialogue.en: Gravy flooded or on the side?

dialogue.ms: Banjir, tapi jangan kena sayur. Kuah kari ye, bukan kuah ikan.
dialogue.en: Flooded, but don't let it touch the vegetables. Curry gravy, okay, not fish gravy.

dialogue.ms: Okay boss, set. Makan sini kan? Air order kat meja ye.
dialogue.en: Okay boss, done. Eating here, right? Order drinks at the table.

dialogue.ms: Okay, terima kasih bang.
dialogue.en: Okay, thank you.

gist.q: Why did she choose the chicken over the fish?
options: The fish has bones and chicken is easier
gist.why: Ikan kembung memang ada tulang … ambik ayam je, senang.

listen.ms: Tu ayam masak merah. Sebelah tu ikan kembung goreng.
listen.en: That's ayam masak merah. Next to it is fried mackerel.
wrong: That's fried mackerel. Next to it is ayam masak merah.
That's fried chicken; the fish is finished.

listen.ms: Kuah letak tepi je, jangan banjir.
listen.en: Gravy on the side only, don't flood it.

listen.ms: Ayam tu pedas jugak. Kalau tak tahan, ambik ikan goreng je.
listen.en: That chicken is fairly spicy. If you can't take it, just have the fried fish.
wrong: The fish is spicy; take the chicken instead.
The chicken isn't spicy, but it has bones.

listen.ms: Nasi separuh je. Ikan kembung satu, sayur campur sikit. Kuah ikan ye, bukan kuah kari, letak tepi.
listen.en: Just half rice. One mackerel, a bit of mixed veg. Fish gravy, not curry, on the side.

read.right: Nasi biasa je, tak payah tambah.
read.why: Either/or: pick one, and tak payah turns down the extra.

read.ms: Yang merah tu ayam ke ikan?
read.en: Is the red one chicken or fish?

read.prompt: Ikan kembung ada tulang sikit. Okay ke?
wrong: Kuah kari ye, bukan kuah ikan.
read.why: Can't be bothered with bones: malas lah, take the chicken.

read.ms: Air order kat meja, bukan kat sini.
read.en: Order drinks at the table, not here.
